title: Multiplicative spectral functions on some Banach function algebras
summary: In this paper, we study multiplicative functions $\varphi \colon A \to \Bbb C$ on a natural Banach function algebra $A$ on a compact Hausdorff space $X$, such that $\varphi(f)\in σ(f)$ for all $f\in A$. It is shown that for certain natural Banach function algebras $A$, either $\ker(\varphi)$ is a maximal ideal of $A$ or $1\in {\rm span}({\rm ker}(\varphi))$ (that is $1=f_1+f_2+\cdots f_n$ for some $f_1,..., f_n \in {\rm ker}(\varphi)$).
